2.en:
Recent events (last 2 hours)

  • Strike: Israeli UAV struck a Hamas police point near the Ma'awiya mosque in NW Rafah. Reported 2 killed and several wounded.
  • Houthis claim they fired two ballistic missiles at King Khalid Airport in Riyadh and at a financial center. (Claim)
  • Visual confirmation: Houthis driving in newly liberated areas. Destroyed and abandoned Saudi/PLC vehicles observed.
  • Jordan apprehended an Israeli who swam toward the kingdom via the Red Sea.
  • Iranian statements:
    • AEOI chief says Iran expects to commission its first controlled nuclear fusion facility as scheduled.
    • Iran says it “won’t remain in 'neither war nor peace' state.” (Anadolu)
  • NATO reportedly cancelled its 2027 summit in Albania, citing tensions over defense spending and the wars in Iran and Ukraine. (Tass/Associated)

Threat trend: Increasing regional tensions based on recent missile claims, Houthi ground advances and strikes.

🟢 Good News: Jordan prevented an unauthorized maritime entry by apprehending the swimmer.

  • תקיפה: כטב"מ ישראלי תקף נקודת משטרה של חמאס בסמוך למסגד מעאוויה, צפון‑מערב רפיח. דווח על 2 הרוגים ומספר פצועים.
  • החות'ים טוענים שהשיגרו שתי טילים בליסטיים לעבר נמל התעופה המלך חאלד בריאד ולעבר מרכז פיננסי. (טענה)
  • אישוש חזותי: חות'ים נעים בשטחים ש"שוחררו" לאחרונה. כלי רכב סעודיים/של PLC הרוסים ונעזבים נראים על הכבישים.
  • ירדן עצרה ישראלי ששחה לעבר הממלכה דרך הים האדום.
  • הצהרות איראניות:
    • ראש ארגון האנרגיה האטומית: איראן צופה להפעיל מתקן היתוך גרעיני מבוקר ראשון לפי לוח הזמנים.
    • איראן: "לא תישאר במצב של 'לא מלחמה ולא שלום'". (אנאדולו)
  • נאט"ו דיווחה שתבטל את פסגת 2027 באלבניה, נימוק: מתחים על הוצאות ביטחון ומלחמות באיראן ואוקראינה. (Tass/Associated)

מגמת איום: מתיחות אזורית גוברת על בסיס טענות לירי טילים, התקדמות חזיתית ותקיפות.

🟢 חדשות טובות: ירדן מנעה כניסה ימית בלתי מורשית ועצרה את השחיין.

Situation Report — 15 Nov 2026

  • Active strikes / launches: Israeli UAV struck a Hamas police post near the Ma'awiya mosque in NW Rafah — 2 killed, multiple wounded. IRGC released footage of Shahed-136 drones striking Riffa Air Base in Bahrain (site hosts U.S. air‑defense radar). Houthis claim two ballistic missiles hit King Khalid Airport and a Riyadh financial center. A surface‑to‑air missile was launched from Qeshm as Iranian air defenses engaged surveillance drones.
  • Gaza Strip: 70 bodies recovered from rubble; thousands still missing. Mass funerals reported in Gaza. Hamas reports casualties since the Oct 2025 ceasefire (self‑reported figures).
  • Northern border / Lebanon: IDF: 300th Brigade (91st Division) operating in the Security Zone to remove threats. IDF dismantled a ~35m underground tunnel with two Hezbollah living quarters in Majdal Zoun.
  • Bahrain / U.S. bases: IRGC footage and open reporting show strikes/drones aimed at a U.S. base and radar assets in Bahrain.
  • Yemen / Houthis: Houthis report regaining Dhubab Airport, cutting the southern coastal road, pushing south in Lahij to encircle PLC units; visual footage shows Houthis driving in newly seized areas. PLC elements reportedly fled toward Aden.
  • Diplomatic / alliance impacts: NATO has canceled its planned 2027 leaders' summit in Albania and is reducing high‑level meetings, citing tensions including the wars in Iran and Ukraine.
  • Other: Jordan apprehended an Israeli who swam toward the kingdom. Times of Israel (citing NYT) reports Israel kidnapped Iranian generals and killed one during efforts to locate Ron Arad.
  • Threat trend: Increased regional kinetic activity across multiple fronts — Iran, Gulf, Yemen, Gaza, and Lebanon.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF reported dismantling a Hezbollah tunnel in southern Lebanon.

Situation report — 15 Nov 2026 (last 48h)

  • Active strikes / launches:
    • Israeli UAV strike on a Hamas police post near Ma'awiya mosque, NW Rafah — local reports: 2 killed, several wounded.
    • IRGC released footage of Shahed-136 drone strikes on Riffa Air Base (Bahrain) — base hosts U.S. air‑defense radar systems.
    • Houthis claim two ballistic missiles struck King Khalid Airport and a financial center in Riyadh.
  • Northern border / Lebanon: IDF 300th Brigade (91st Division) conducting Security Zone operations in southern Lebanon to remove threats. IDF reported dismantling a ~35m underground tunnel with two Hezbollah living quarters near Majdal Zoun.
  • Yemen / Red Sea front: Houthis continue offensive in southern Yemen — pushing south in Lahij, cutting the southern coastal road, regaining Dhubab Airport, and forcing PLC elements to flee toward Aden. Visuals show Houthis driving in newly claimed areas.
  • Iran / Gulf: IRGC footage also shows strikes on a U.S. base in Bahrain. Iranian air defenses launched a surface‑to‑air missile from Qeshm against surveillance drones. Iran’s AEOI chief says Iran expects to commission its first controlled nuclear fusion facility as scheduled.
  • Gaza / civilian impact: 70 bodies recovered from Gaza rubble; thousands still missing. Mass funerals reported. Hamas channels claim casualty totals since Oct 2025 ceasefire: 1,647 dead, 5,969 wounded (as reported by local sources).
  • Other incidents: Jordan detained an Israeli who swam toward the kingdom via the Red Sea.
  • Alliances / diplomacy: NATO announced cancellation of its planned 2027 summit in Albania and a reduction of high‑level meetings, citing tensions over defense spending and the wars in Iran and Ukraine.
  • Threat trend: Escalating across multiple fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Gulf, Yemen) based on recent strikes, launches and offensives.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF reported successful dismantling of an underground tunnel used by Hezbollah near Majdal Zoun.
